title: Codeium updates from January 2025
description: Monthly product updates for Codeium extensions and Windsurf Editor including new features and improvements.

title: Introducing Windsurf Next prerelease version
description: Launch of Windsurf Next, an opt-in prerelease version of the Windsurf Editor with new features.

title: DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, and OpenAI o3-mini now available
description: Added support for DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, and OpenAI o3-mini models in Windsurf.

title: Introducing Wave 2 updates
description: Second batch of updates to the Windsurf Editor with new features and improvements.

title: Codeium updates from December 2024
description: Monthly product updates for Codeium extensions and Windsurf Editor.

title: Version 2.1.126 Released
description: Major update including OAuth improvements, PowerShell tool support, Windows PowerShell 7 detection, enhanced MCP connector management, and numerous bug fixes for permission handling, image processing, and terminal rendering.

title: Upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex
description: GitHub announced the deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex models from Copilot.

title: Visual Studio — April update
description: Monthly update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio with performance improvements and bug fixes.

title: Version 0.128.0 Released
description: Added persistent /goal workflows allowing users to set detailed objectives that persist across multiple turns until achieved. Features include GPT-5.5 integration, app-server APIs, TUI controls for create/pause/resume/clear, and runtime continuation.

title: Version 2.1.123 Released
description: Hotfix for OAuth authentication failing with 401 retry loop when experimental betas are disabled.

title: Version 2.1.122 Released
description: Added Bedrock service tier support, PR URL paste feature for /resume, enhanced MCP management UI, and multiple fixes for Vertex AI, Bedrock, and OAuth connectivity issues.

title: Copilot Student GPT-5.3-Codex removal from model picker
description: GPT-5.3-Codex model removed from Copilot Student plan model selection.

title: Copilot cloud agent starts 20% faster with Actions custom images
description: Performance improvement for Copilot cloud agent when using GitHub Actions custom images.

title: Copilot code review will start consuming GitHub Actions minutes on June 1, 2026
description: Announcement that Copilot code review will consume GitHub Actions minutes starting June 1, 2026.

title: GPT-5.5 is generally available
description: GPT-5.5 model is now generally available for GitHub Copilot users.

title: Inline agent mode in preview for JetBrains IDEs
description: Inline agent mode feature preview for GitHub Copilot in JetBrains IDEs.

title: Copilot Chat improvements for pull requests
description: Enhancements to Copilot Chat functionality specifically for pull request workflows.

title: Copilot cloud agent fields added to usage metrics
description: New usage metrics fields added to track Copilot cloud agent activity.

title: Better debugging with GitHub Copilot on the web
description: Improvements to Copilot debugging capabilities when using GitHub on the web.

title: View and manage agent sessions from issues and projects
description: New feature allowing management of Copilot agent sessions directly from GitHub issues and projects.
